section_a_six_dimension_entries.operational_definition: Engagement with avatar or game-piece control in a virtual environment, spanning from conscious learning of the controls through to fluent internalized movement; foregrounded when the controls make themselves present, either through unmastery or because a situation demands a complex sequence of actions that taxes the player.
boundary_criteria: Locus of attention is the control surface (avatar manipulation) rather than the environment itself — distinguishes from SPATIAL
Foregrounded under unmastery or complex-sequence demand; recedes upon internalization
Ergodic-dispositional under-determination: includes readiness-to-act even when no physical input is occurring (confusable with LUDIC; apply R1)
Internalized state shows reduced attentional load measurable in resource-reallocation to other dimensions (Calleja's 'Quan'/thinking-with-fingers)
Avatar/miniature scaling: control can vest in single avatar or distributed across miniatures (Empire: Total War 20-unit)
section_a_six_dimension_entries.macro_phase_signature: Recalling impressive feats of avatar control between sessions; mental rehearsal of complex-sequence inputs; motor-habit retention.
section_a_six_dimension_entries.micro_phase_signature: Control-internalization sequence; readiness-to-act poised on conditions (Red Orchestra sniper, Figure 3.2); continuity-of-movement (Mirror's Edge).

section_b_incorporation_rubric.rubric_design_note: Phase 1 identified 8 candidate components; Phase 2 normalized to 5 constitutive (the 4-component reading — assimilation/embodiment/simultaneity/blending — augmented by the spatial+kinesthetic-cornerstone Calleja flags as necessary minimum-pair).

components.name: Assimilation axis (env INTO player consciousness)
components.differentiator: merely-involved play engages env as object; incorporation absorbs env into structure of consciousness (Lakoff+Johnson experiential gestalts)

components.name: Embodiment axis (player INTO env via avatar)
components.differentiator: non-avatar games (Tetris) excluded — no systemically-upheld single-location

components.name: Simultaneity condition
components.differentiator: strictest gatekeeper; macro-only assimilation = involvement, not incorporation

components.name: Spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone
components.differentiator: new-player CS:S double-door fumbling fails cornerstone; Tetris fails (no habitable space, no avatar-located embodiment)

components.name: Blending of multiple dimensions
components.differentiator: merely-involved is single-dim or thin-blend; incorporation requires intensified multi-dim blending at temporal-axis apex

differentiator_summary_5_conditions: Experience reaches temporal-axis apex (post-internalization sustained micro)
Intrusions are integrated rather than ruptured

candidate_theoretical_bridge_incorporati.leverage: Burkean consubstantiation parallels incorporation's double-axis: assimilation = env-consubstantiated-with-player; embodiment = player-consubstantiated-with-avatar; SHARED-overlap = player-consubstantiated-with-co-agents

signature_layer_c_argument_umwelt_over_w.claim: Uexküll's Umwelt is more apt than Heideggerian In-der-Welt-sein for the bounded, designer-constituted nature of virtual environments
independent_triangulating_findings: IG-10 Manual §E warrant: R4 cornerstone explicitly mapped to Funktionskreis + Umwelt
signature_layer_c_argument_umwelt_over_w.why_umwelt_fits_better: Heideggerian Welt = unbounded holistic significance-totality, un-designed (constituted via Dasein's thrown engagement). Virtual game-environments are bounded (Azeroth's 96 regions), designer-constituted (Blizzard team), ruleful (mechanics enforce edges), finite. Umwelt = species-specific subjective world from closed-set Bedeutungsträger and biologically-bounded channels — IS bounded, IS pre-given-to-subject (analogous to designer-constitution), IS species-specific (analogous to genre-specific affordance-set).
